import re
PROMPT = re.compile(r"^\S+@\S+> ")
RULE = re.compile(r"^-{10,}\s*$")
HEAD = re.compile(r"^ID\s+Application\s+State\s+Type\s+Flag|^Vsys\s+Dst\[Dport\]/Zone")
SRC = re.compile(r"^(?P<id>\d+)\s+(?P<application>\S+)\s+(?P<state>\S+)\s+(?P<type>\S+)\s+"
                 r"(?:(?P<flag>[A-Z]+)\s+)?(?P<src>[^\s\[]+)\[(?P<sport>\d+)\]/(?P<zone>[^\s/]+)/(?P<proto>\d+)"
                 r"\s+\((?P<tip>[^\s\[]+)\[(?P<tport>\d+)\]\)\s*$")
DST = re.compile(r"^(?P<vsys>vsys\S*)\s+(?P<dst>[^\s\[]+)\[(?P<dport>\d+)\]/(?P<zone>\S+)"
                 r"\s+\((?P<tip>[^\s\[]+)\[(?P<tport>\d+)\]\)\s*$")
COLS = ["ID", "Application", "State", "Type", "Flag", "Src", "Sport", "Src Zone", "Proto",
        "Src translated IP", "Src translated Port", "Vsys", "Dst", "Dport", "Dst Zone",
        "Dst translated IP", "Dst translated Port"]

def parse(lines):
    recs, used, skip = [], [], []
    cur = None
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        if PROMPT.match(ln) or RULE.match(ln):
            skip.append(j)
            continue
        if HEAD.match(ln):
            used.append(j)
            continue
        m = SRC.match(ln)
        if m:
            g = m.groupdict()
            cur = {c: "" for c in COLS}
            cur.update({"ID": g["id"], "Application": g["application"], "State": g["state"],
                        "Type": g["type"], "Flag": g["flag"] or "", "Src": g["src"], "Sport": g["sport"],
                        "Src Zone": g["zone"], "Proto": g["proto"], "Src translated IP": g["tip"],
                        "Src translated Port": g["tport"]})
            recs.append(cur)
            used.append(j)
            continue
        m = DST.match(ln)
        if m and cur is not None:
            g = m.groupdict()
            # the second line of the same session
            cur.update({"Vsys": g["vsys"], "Dst": g["dst"], "Dport": g["dport"], "Dst Zone": g["zone"],
                        "Dst translated IP": g["tip"], "Dst translated Port": g["tport"]})
            used.append(j)
            cur = None
    return {"blocks": [{"name": "sessions", "kind": "table", "lines": used, "records": recs}],
            "skip": skip}
